scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
other_conditions: Applicant must have multiple disabilities (more than one type)
Applicant must have a severe disability of 80% or above in any one type
Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹500 (₹300 Central contribution + ₹200 State contribution).
